page.overview:
Who is Blast Master?

Blast Master loves receiving orders. He's eager to load up on equipment. He's enthusiastic about blasting off into space. He's delighted to engage in battle. He's also quite likely to screw up bigtime, thanks to all this reckless enthusiasm.

His combiner partner on the Astro Squad is Phaser.
